description: List a page of a collection's records (drafts + published — the author view). Each record carries EVERY field of its schema, so a wide collection costs tens of thousands of characters per page — pass `fields` to keep only what you need (e.g. ["name","install_cmd"]) and `limit` to bound the page. The record envelope (slug/status/dates/seo) is always returned; `fields` narrows the `data` object only.

fields.description: Field ids to keep in each record's `data`. Omit for all fields. Unknown ids are ignored.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

workspace.description: Workspace/brand to act on (defaults to your active workspace).

name: collection_record_list
